https://apps.shopify.com/terms-and-condi.complaint_status: Three one-star reviews inspected. Recurring pricing-transparency concern; no current defect established.

complaints.summary: Two merchants reported difficulty finding a free plan (May 2025 and January 2026). A July 2026 review questioned subscription pricing.
complaints.status: The developer explained in August 2026 that the free plan is limited to development stores. Pricing expectations, not proof of deceptive billing.

https://apps.shopify.com/barcode-managem.complaint_status: Five one-star reviews inspected. Support availability and reliability warrant validation.

complaints.summary: Two merchants reported waiting for chat support (January and August 2026).
complaints.status: The developer acknowledged a January delay and explained that the small support team was offline.

complaints.summary: An August 2026 reviewer reported a lost label design; a February reviewer described general unreliability.
complaints.status: Merchant allegations; current reproducibility unknown. Separate billing criticism was disputed by the developer.

https://apps.shopify.com/trust-badge-by-.complaint_status: Four historical one-star reviews inspected in a source indexed six months before research. Current issue status unknown.

complaints.summary: Two 2024 merchants described storefront interference: scrolling/layout problems and broken menu/search interactions.
complaints.status: Historical theme-compatibility concern. The developer requested diagnostics; no current reproduction verified.

complaints.summary: Another 2024 merchant reported unwanted referral branding on some pages.
complaints.status: Single report, not a recurring theme. Developer acknowledged the complaint and requested details.

https://apps.shopify.com/yanet-barcode-l.complaint_status: Seven one-star entries inspected; six contained review text. Recurring printing and support concerns span different years.

complaints.summary: A March 2026 merchant reported label dimensions differing from previews and unreadable output. Two 2023 merchants described printing/template failures and difficulty reaching support.
complaints.status: Historical and recent allegations; current reproduction unknown.
The developer attributed this to input country/GS1 prefixes. Validate identifiers and clarify that generating a number does not establish ownership of a prefix.

https://apps.shopify.com/zigpoll.complaint_status: One one-star review inspected. No recurring complaint established.

complaints.summary: An April 2026 merchant criticized AI-analysis accuracy.
complaints.status: The developer offered to investigate and improve account-specific analysis. Single report; deterministic surveys without AI are a possible narrower scope, not proof of demand for an alternative.

https://apps.shopify.com/dealer-store-lo.complaint_status: Four one-star entries inspected; three contained merchant text. Different historical concerns, not a demonstrated recurring defect.

complaints.summary: An April 2024 merchant reported imported locations missing from the map and unhelpful support.
complaints.status: Current reproduction unknown. Validate CSV imports and report geocoding failures explicitly.

complaints.summary: A February 2023 merchant objected to separate Google API billing; a November 2023 merchant reported setup failure.
complaints.status: The developer offered a legacy API-key arrangement and explained that custom themes may need manual setup. Current plans and compatibility require rechecking.
